setup.title: Welcome to Hagane Works
setup.intro: Choose where your projects live. Each project is a normal folder in it that you can copy, back up or put under version control.
setup.projectsDirHelp: Every project is saved as a folder here. Pick an empty folder or one you already use for Hagane Works.
setup.gameDirHelp: The game preview and the base-game data are read from your own copy of the game. Nothing from the game is included in this program.
setup.gameMissing: Not found automatically. Choose the folder that contains hoi4.exe.

settings.title: Hagane Works settings
settings.cwtoolsModifiers: {count, plural, one {# modifier name read} other {# modifier names read}}
settings.cwtoolsAbout: Optional, and used only to check modifier names when exporting: these rules come from the third-party CWTools project (MIT license) and can be downloaded from <link>github.com/cwtools/cwtools-hoi4-config</link>.
settings.portAbout: The local port Hagane Works listens on; leave it empty for the default. A change takes effect the next time you start the program. What the window remembers (theme, language, favorites) belongs to its address, so on a new port it starts fresh.
settings.cpuAbout: How many processor cores Hagane Works may keep busy while it imports a mod or reads your game. Fewer leaves more for other programs; all is fastest.

avatar.title: Your local avatar
avatar.about: Choose a built-in companion or your own image. It stays on this computer and is never added to a mod export.
avatar.uploadHelp: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 10 MB. The image is cropped to a square.
avatar.invalidType: Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
avatar.tooLarge: The image must be 10 MB or smaller.
avatar.failed: This image could not be used or saved on this computer.

gameIndex.title: Reference lists from your game
gameIndex.about: Hagane Works reads your own copy of the game to build its reference lists: countries, ideas, equipment and more. Nothing from the game is shipped with the program.
gameIndex.buildingHint: You can keep working. Pages that need these lists wait until they are ready.
gameIndex.importWaiting: Waiting for the reference lists from your game…
gameIndex.failed: The lists could not be built.

install.title: Install into the game
install.hint: Builds the mod and puts it into {folder}, so the game launcher lists it.
install.done: Installed. Enable it in the game launcher's playset.

unsaved.title: Unsaved changes
unsaved.body: Some changes are not saved yet. Close Hagane Works anyway? They will be lost.
